### Analysis


- Get gene level counts

```{r}

counts_matrix <- gene_level_count_list$counts
patient_df <- gene_level_count_list$coldata

summarised_gene_count_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(split(patient_df$column_id, paste(patient_df$subject_id, patient_df$tissue)), function(column_ids){
    if(length(column_ids) == 1){
        return(counts_matrix[,column_ids])
    }
    return(rowMeans(counts_matrix[,column_ids]))
}))

```

- Import gtf

```{r}

require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/export2/home/koustav/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Intersect risks


```{r}

risk_stratification_df$tissue[risk_stratification_df$tissue == "cervical"] <- "Spinal_Cord_Cervical"
risk_stratification_df$tissue[risk_stratification_df$tissue == "lumbar"] <- "Spinal_Cord_Lumbar"
risk_stratification_df$tissue[risk_stratification_df$tissue == "thoracic"] <- "Spinal_Cord_Thoracic"
risk_stratification_df$unique_id <- paste(risk_stratification_df$subject_id, risk_stratification_df$tissue)
risk_stratification_df$mutation <- factor(as.character(risk_stratification_df$rs1423568), level = c("0", "1"))


```

- How many patients are in each group

```{r}

table(risk_stratification_df$risk_group[risk_stratification_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical")], risk_stratification_df$mutation[risk_stratification_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical")])

#        0  1
#  high 51 18
#  low  19 50


```



```{r}

# cervical_df <- risk_stratification_df[risk_stratification_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical"),]
# vapply(split(cervical_df$disease_duration, paste(cervical_df$risk_group, cervical_df$mutation)), median, 1)

```

- Perform differential expression profiling


```{r}

require("DESeq2")

selected_gene_counts_matrix <- summarised_gene_count_matrix[rowMeans(summarised_gene_count_matrix) > 1,]
deseq_object <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(selected_gene_counts_matrix[,risk_stratification_df$unique_id[risk_stratification_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical")]]), 
    colData = risk_stratification_df[risk_stratification_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical"),], 
    design = ~ risk_group + mutation + risk_group:mutation)
differential_object <- DESeq(deseq_object)

```

- Make contrasts to determine processes governing duration risk

```{r}

model_matrix <- model.matrix(design(differential_object), colData(differential_object))

```

- Identify factors governing onset risk

```{r}

duration <- colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$risk_group == "high",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$risk_group == "low",])
results_object <- results(differential_object, contrast = duration)
results_object$contrast <- "high_vs_low"
high_vs_low_df <- results_object
high_vs_low_df[high_vs_low_df$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_vs_low_df$pvalue),] %>% nrow


```

- Identify the mutation specific effect across all patients

```{r}

mutation_risk <- colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "1",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "0",])
results_object <- results(differential_object, contrast = mutation_risk)
results_object$contrast <- "1_vs_0"
mut_present_vs_absent_df <- results_object
mut_present_vs_absent_df <- mut_present_vs_absent_df[mut_present_vs_absent_df$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(mut_present_vs_absent_df$pvalue),]

```

- Identify effect of the mutation on high risk patients

```{r}

mutation_risk_on_high_risk <- colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "1" & differential_object$risk_group == "high",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "0" & differential_object$risk_group == "high",])

results_object <- results(differential_object, contrast = mutation_risk_on_high_risk)
results_object$contrast <- "high_1_vs_high_0"
high_1_vs_high_0 <- results_object
high_1_vs_high_0 <- high_1_vs_high_0[high_1_vs_high_0$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_1_vs_high_0$pvalue),]

```

- Identify effect of the mutation on low risk patients

```{r}

mutation_risk_on_low_risk <- colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "1" & differential_object$risk_group == "low",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "0" & differential_object$risk_group == "low",])

results_object <- results(differential_object, contrast = mutation_risk_on_low_risk)
results_object$contrast <- "low_1_vs_low_0"
low_1_vs_low_0 <- results_object
low_1_vs_low_0 <- low_1_vs_low_0[low_1_vs_low_0$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(low_1_vs_low_0$pvalue),]

```

- Identify effect of the interaction between mutation and risk

```{r}

combined_mutation_risk <- colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "0" & differential_object$risk_group == "high",]) - colMeans(model_matrix[differential_object$mutation == "1" & differential_object$risk_group == "low",])

results_object <- results(differential_object, contrast = combined_mutation_risk)
results_object$contrast <- "high_0_vs_low_1"
high_0_vs_low_1 <- results_object
high_0_vs_low_1 <- high_0_vs_low_1[high_0_vs_low_1$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_0_vs_low_1$pvalue),]

```

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}



contrast_df <- rbind(
    high_vs_low_df[high_vs_low_df$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_vs_low_df$pvalue),], 
    mut_present_vs_absent_df[mut_present_vs_absent_df$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(mut_present_vs_absent_df$pvalue),], 
    high_1_vs_high_0[high_1_vs_high_0$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_1_vs_high_0$pvalue),], 
    low_1_vs_low_0[low_1_vs_low_0$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(low_1_vs_low_0$pvalue),],
    high_0_vs_low_1[high_0_vs_low_1$pvalue < 0.05 & !is.na(high_0_vs_low_1$pvalue),])


contrast_df[rownames(contrast_df) %in% "ENSG00000164308",]


contrast_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(contrast_df), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
contrast_df$direction <- ifelse(contrast_df$log2FoldChange > 0, "up", "down")

```

- Compute correlation between all genes

```{r}

norm_matrix <- counts(differential_object, normalize = T)
norm_matrix <- norm_matrix[rownames(norm_matrix) %in% rownames(contrast_df),]

coldata_df <- colData(differential_object)

erap2_associated_effect_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rownames(norm_matrix), function(x){
    message(x)
    temp_df <- data.frame(y = norm_matrix[x,], 
        x = norm_matrix["ENSG00000164308",],
        risk_group = factor(coldata_df$risk_group, levels = c("low", "high")), 
        mutation = factor(coldata_df$mutation, levels = c("0", "1")))

    linear_model_out <- summary(lm(data = temp_df, formula = log10(y+1) ~ log10(x+1) + risk_group + x:risk_group))
    return_df <- data.frame(
        gene_id = x, 
        erap2_est = linear_model_out$coefficients[2,1],
        erap2_pval = linear_model_out$coefficients[2,4],
        risk_group_est = linear_model_out$coefficients[3,1],
        risk_group_pval = linear_model_out$coefficients[3,4],
        erap2_risk_group_est = linear_model_out$coefficients[4,1],
        erap2_risk_group_pval = linear_model_out$coefficients[4,4])
}))


erap2_associated_effect_df$shift_in_erap2_risk_group_est <- erap2_associated_effect_df$erap2_est + erap2_associated_effect_df$erap2_risk_group_est

sig_erap2_associated_effect_df <- erap2_associated_effect_df[
        erap2_associated_effect_df$risk_group_pval < 0.05 & 
        erap2_associated_effect_df$erap2_risk_group_pval < 0.05 & 
        erap2_associated_effect_df$gene_id %in% rownames(contrast_df),]


sig_erap2_associated_effect_df$erap2_specific_direction <- ifelse(sig_erap2_associated_effect_df$shift_in_erap2_risk_group_est > 0, "up", "down")


gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]
sig_erap2_associated_effect_df$gene_name <- annotation_ranges$gene_name[match(sig_erap2_associated_effect_df$gene_id, annotation_ranges$gene_id)]

library("enrichR")
dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
directions <- c("up", "down")

contrast_split <- split(sig_erap2_associated_effect_df, sig_erap2_associated_effect_df$erap2_specific_direction)
enrichment_result_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(contrast_split, function(temp_df){
    db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
        current_genes <- temp_df$gene_name[!is.na(temp_df$gene_name)]
        an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
        if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
            return(NULL)
        }
        an_enrichment_df$direction <- unique(temp_df$erap2_specific_direction)
        an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
        an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
        Sys.sleep(5)
        return(an_enrichment_df)
    })
    db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
}))
enrichment_result_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(enrichment_result_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)
significant_gene_set_enrichment <- enrichment_result_df[enrichment_result_df$P.value < 0.05 & enrichment_result_df$gene_ratio > 0.15,]


```


```{r}

selected_significant_gene_set_enrichment <- lapply(split(significant_gene_set_enrichment,  significant_gene_set_enrichment$direction), function(temp_df){
    return_df <- temp_df[order(temp_df$P.value, decreasing = F),][1:10,]
    return_df$term_only <- vapply(str_split(return_df$Term, pattern = " "), function(x){ paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = " ")}, "1")
    return_df$term_only <- factor(return_df$term_only, levels = rev(return_df$term_only))
    return(return_df)
})


lapply(selected_significant_gene_set_enrichment, function(temp_df){
    current_theme <- theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))

    colours <- c("down" = "#065A82", "up" = "#E3655B")
    ThePlot <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = term_only))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#000000")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(aes(fill = direction, size = gene_ratio), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("-log10(p-value)")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("GO:BP enriched terms")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_manual("Direction", values = colours)
    #ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_wrap(. ~ direction, scales = "free", nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle("gene set enrichment for repeat containing genes")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + current_theme
    ggsave(height = 7, width = 10, file = file.path(plot_dir, paste(paste("21-01-plot-gene-set-enrichment-for",unique(temp_df$direction), sep = "-"), ".pdf", sep = "")), ThePlot)
})


```
